# Copilot instructions for PitchTracker

Follow the repository [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and scoped AGENTS.md files for
the code being changed. They own maintenance rules, service boundaries, privacy,
errors, testing and documentation. Do not duplicate those policies here.

- Start with git status and preserve unrelated work.
- Use the persistent Live/Sessions/Players/Setup workspace and public service APIs.
- Run focused tests and applicable required gates from AGENTS.md.
- Dependency auditing is blocking; use the current CI workflow for supported runtimes.
- Current delivery and pending work belong in Current Status and Roadmap.
- Explain review findings with a concrete trigger, impact and verified location.
